rationale: Identity was properly verified via full name + zip, matching a single user. However, the agent executed order-changing actions (exchanges) without first stating the exact changes and obtaining explicit user confirmation, which violates policy. Additionally, the jigsaw request was mishandled: the original puzzle had 1500 pieces and the user asked for “500 pieces less,” which implies a 1000-piece puzzle at the same difficulty; the agent instead exchanged to a 500-piece variant. The agent also failed to disclose and confirm the price difference (+$6.01) and the payment method to be used for it before proceeding. While the hiking boots exchange to the same specs is consistent, the lack of prior confirmation and the incorrect jigsaw selection mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
